diff:
--- a/tests/test-design.json
+++ b/tests/test-design.json
@@ -1 +1,140 @@
-{}
+{
+  "task_id": "STAGE20-LABELS",
+  "contract_version": 1,
+  "cases": [
+    {
+      "id": "empty_input",
+      "intent": "Rule 10: empty input returns an empty list.",
+      "input": "",
+      "expected": []
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty_labels_and_ordinary_whitespace",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 5, 6, 9: repeated separators, empty quotes and all six ordinary whitespace characters produce no labels.",
+      "input": ",, \t\r\n\u000b\f,\"\", ,",
+      "expected": []
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "separator_order_and_case",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 6, 8, 10: trim labels, lowercase and retain the order of first occurrences across repeated separators.",
+      "input": ",Beta,, ALPHA ,beta,GAMMA,alpha,",
+      "expected": ["beta", "alpha", "gamma"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quote_concatenation_anywhere",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 8, 10: adjacent quoted and unquoted segments concatenate and normalize to the same label.",
+      "input": "AB\"CD\"EF\"GH\"I,\"ABC\"DEFGHI,A\"\"BCDEFGHI",
+      "expected": ["abcdefghi"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quoted_commas",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 8: commas inside quotes are literal, including within a concatenated label and at its boundaries.",
+      "input": "PRE\"A,B\"POST,\",\",\"X,,Y\",END",
+      "expected": ["prea,bpost", ",", "x,,y", "end"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escapes_outside_quotes",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 3, 8: escaped comma, quote and backslash outside quotes are literal; escaped uppercase is lowercased.",
+      "input": "A\\,B,C\\\"D,E\\\\F,\\Z",
+      "expected": ["a,b", "c\"d", "e\\f", "z"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escapes_inside_quotes",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 3, 8: escaping comma, quote, backslash and uppercase inside quotes consumes exactly the next character without changing quoted mode.",
+      "input": "\"A\\,B\\\"C\\\\D\\Z\",NEXT",
+      "expected": ["a,b\"c\\dz", "next"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "all_ordinary_whitespace",
+      "intent": "Rules 5, 6, 8: all six ASCII whitespace characters trim at boundaries and collapse in an internal run.",
+      "input": " \t\r\n\u000b\fA \t\r\n\u000b\f B\f\u000b\n\r\t ",
+      "expected": ["a b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "all_quoted_whitespace_only",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 5, 7, 9: every quoted ASCII whitespace character and its multiplicity is retained in a nonempty whitespace-only label.",
+      "input": "\"  \t\t\r\r\n\n\u000b\u000b\f\f\"",
+      "expected": ["  \t\t\r\r\n\n\u000b\u000b\f\f"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "all_escaped_whitespace_only",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 5, 7, 9: each of the six ASCII whitespace characters can be escaped outside quotes and retained at label boundaries.",
+      "input": "\\ \\\t\\\r\\\n\\\u000b\\\f",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\f"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "mixed_boundary_protection",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 6, 7, 8: trim only the ordinary outer whitespace while preserving quoted and escaped boundary whitespace.",
+      "input": " \t\"  A\t \" \r, \n\\ B\\ \t",
+      "expected": ["  a\t ", " b "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quoted_whitespace_breaks_runs",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 6, 7: ordinary runs on each side of protected whitespace collapse independently; protected whitespace keeps its exact multiplicity.",
+      "input": "A \t\"\t  \" \rB",
+      "expected": ["a \t   b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped_whitespace_breaks_runs",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 6, 7: an escaped tab divides two ordinary runs and remains a tab between their normalized spaces.",
+      "input": "A  \\\t \r\nB",
+      "expected": ["a \t b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty_quotes_do_not_break_runs",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 5, 6, 9: removed empty quote delimiters neither protect adjacent whitespace nor break its runs, even at boundaries.",
+      "input": " \"\" \tA \"\" \tB \"\" , \"\" \t",
+      "expected": ["a b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "deduplicate_after_normalization",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 3, 6, 8, 10: differently written labels become equal after concatenation, ordinary whitespace normalization and lowercasing.",
+      "input": " Z ,A  B,a\tb,\"A\" B,\\A B,z,C,A B",
+      "expected": ["z", "a b", "c"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "protected_equality_and_order",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 6, 7, 9, 10: exact resulting strings deduplicate across quoting and escaping, while different protected multiplicities and boundaries remain distinct.",
+      "input": "\" \",\\ ,\"  \",\\ \\ , ,\"\t\",\\\t,\" A\",A,\"A \",\" A\"",
+      "expected": [" ", "  ", "\t", " a", "a", "a "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "other_ascii_literals",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 8: punctuation, digits and non-whitespace ASCII control characters remain exact; escaping an ordinary letter or punctuation adds no special feature.",
+      "input": "AZ09!#$%&'()*+-./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~\u0000\u0007\u001b\u007f,\\Q\\!",
+      "expected": ["az09!#$%&'()*+-./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~\u0000\u0007\u001b\u007f", "q!"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped_backslash_leaves_next_syntax_active",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 3, 8: escaping a backslash consumes only that backslash; the next comma separates and the next quote toggles normally.",
+      "input": "A\\\\,B\\\\\"C,D\",E",
+      "expected": ["a\\", "b\\c,d", "e"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "trailing_escape_after_valid_and_empty_labels",
+      "intent": "Rules 4, 9, 10: a trailing unpaired backslash invalidates the entire input despite earlier valid, duplicate and empty labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,good,,\"\",BAD\\",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "trailing_escape_in_quotes",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 4: an unpaired backslash inside an unclosed quote invalidates the entire input after valid labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,\"BAD\\",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "unclosed_quote_after_valid_and_duplicate_labels",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 4, 9, 10: a quote opened mid-label and never closed raises for the whole input, regardless of earlier valid, duplicate and empty labels.",
+      "input": "GOOD,,good,\"\",BAD\"MORE,STILL",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped_quote_does_not_close_quote",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 3, 4: an escaped final quote is literal and cannot close quoted mode, so earlier valid labels cannot be returned.",
+      "input": "GOOD,\"BAD\\\"",
+      "expected": null
+    }
+  ],
+  "properties": ["unique_nonempty_labels", "ascii_lowercase"],
+  "rationale": "The 22 deterministic ASCII cases cover every rule and the stated clarifications. Valid expectations apply delimiter and escape handling first, track whitespace protection per emitted character, trim only ordinary boundaries, collapse only ordinary internal runs, lowercase every emitted ASCII uppercase letter, discard only empty strings, and deduplicate by exact normalized equality in first occurrence order. Cases distinguish all six ordinary whitespace characters from quoted and escaped forms, preserve protected-only labels, exercise protected run breaks and empty quote adjacency, and combine normalization with deduplication. Escaped commas, quotes and backslashes are tested in both modes, including syntax immediately following an escaped backslash. Four malformed endings require whole-input ValueError, represented by null, after otherwise valid prefixes. No Unicode or non-string inputs are included."
+}
